title: CFrame Zero Admin Menu
features:
Hey! This is one of my newest and greatest  scripts so far: CFrame Zero, a compact command/admin-style menu with many client-side tools, customization pages, keybinds, mobile support, and saved settings.

DELTA IS SUPPORTED SO FAR — MOBILE CONTROLS ARE INCLUDED, BUT IT IS DEFINITELY HARDER TO NAVIGATE THROUGH ON MOBILE!

FEATURES:

COMMANDS:

PLAYER:
- bang <player>
- unbang
- carpet <player>
- uncarpet
- esp <all/player/team>
- unesp
- hitbox <size> <all/player/team>
- resethitboxes
- tpwalk <speed>
- untpwalk
- walkspeed / ws <speed>
- unwalkspeed / unws
- jumppower / jp <amount>
- unjumppower / unjp

- resethipheight
- noclipcam
- unnoclipcam

- resetminzoom
- sit

FEATURES:

- Compact draggable UI
- Full mobile support
- Command search
- Command autocomplete
- Command aliases
- Active modules display
- Keybind support

- Saves your settings

- ESP customization

- ESP overhead settings

- Built-in server info
- Built-in player info
- Built-in team list
- Built-in join logs
- Built-in terminal/log system
- Key system support
- Admin key support
- Cloudflare analytics support
- Auto cleanup on re-execute
- Auto cleanup when UI is destroyed
- Mobile-friendly reset / disable buttons
- Editable settings
